name: Blade Ruiner (VST3)
description: A free Windows VST3 atmospheric synthesiser in three layers, each with its own engine and its own room. LOS ANGELES is a drone that does not stop — nine detuned oscillators on a chord, filtered rain, grains of kipple and a shimmering reverb big enough to lose a city in. DECKARD is an eight-voice polysynth built the way the big Japanese machine of 1977 was built, with a ladder filter, a late-arriving vibrato and an ensemble chorus that does most of the emotional work. REPLICANT is a sixteen-step FM sequencer whose entire pattern is a six-bit seed. Any combination can run at once, and at least one of them always is. All three run out through the Brokild World Rack — twelve shared effect pedals and six SPECTRA characters that possess the voices rather than process them — and the mood organ still writes the whole machine from a single number.
note: Windows VST3 · build 260826.5 · free download · 18-page manual included.
